localAssetInventory.method: Filename inventory of matching stage/cosmetic directories and reading the two local HarryPotter/Fallout cosmetic reference manifests. This is a selected local inventory, not a claim that all source props are absent from every project file.
localAssetInventory.interpretation: The existing cosmetic sheets document portal/KO/presentation rows, not these24 scene mechanisms. They are neither relabelled as official frames nor used as universal portals.
